summary: Dark backgrounds (flat or gradient), thin white border at 20% opacity, OR image-bg with dark-faded overlay + light/accent text. Headings ALL CAPS.

colors.notes: Accent colours used 'where needed' — i.e. for CTAs, highlights, key words. Background MUST be one of the two dark colours (flat or gradient between them).

borders.stroke_width_px_relative: thin (visual ratio ~1px per 1080px image, i.e. ~0.1% of width)

type_a.name: flat_or_gradient_dark_background
type_a.border: thin white at 20% opacity, around image edge
type_a.text: white or accent colour over dark background

type_b.name: image_with_dark_fade_overlay
type_b.overlay: gradient of dark colour faded over image
type_b.text: light or accent colour above overlay

headings.use: page titles, section titles, hero text

body.weight: (not specified; default to Regular or Demi)

compliance_rules: Headings MUST be Avenir Next Heavy Italic
Body MUST be Avenir Next Italic

voice_refs.note: Voice bible governs copy; this file governs visuals.
